about: Verified duplicate public.players rows (JEG-1351 path B). The duplicate row stays in the table; canonical_players and player_key_index resolve it to the original. Each entry needs the same person proven by ids: the duplicate's Sleeper id maps through gsis (data/inputs/sleeper_projection_idmap.csv, status matched) to the original's gsis_id. tests/test_jeg1351_sleeper_duplicates.py checks every entry against the idmap.
